en: A black-and-white image showing a European town square from an elevated perspective. The image prominently features two large churches with tall steeples and domes, historical buildings with ornate facades, a central square with people gathered, and a monument or fountain. There are hills in the background. At the bottom of the image, there is a faint reversed handwritten text.
